question: The High Court and Supreme Court Judges (Salaries and Conditions of Service) Amendment Bill, 2021 was introduced in the Lok Sabha on ______________by the Minister of Law and Justice, Kiren Rijiju.
solution:
The correct answer is __**November 2021**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The High Court and Supreme Court Judges (Salaries and Conditions of Service) Amendment Bill, 2021 **was presented in the** Lok Sabha on November 30, 2021, by Mr Kiren Rijiju, the Minister of Law and Justice**.
 
• This Bill aims to modify the High Court Judges (Salaries and Conditions of Service) Act, 1954, and the Supreme Court Judges (Salaries and Conditions of Service) Act, 1958.
 
• These statutes govern the remuneration and terms of service for judges of the High Courts and the Supreme Court in India.
 
• According to these laws, retired judges of the Supreme Court and High Courts, as well as their family members, are entitled to receive a pension or family pension.
 
• Additionally, they are eligible for an increased pension or family pension upon reaching a certain age, as per a specified scale.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The scale outlined in the **Bill comprises** five age brackets, starting from a minimum age of 80 and progressing to 100 years, with **increments at 85, 90, 95, and 100 years**.
 
• The additional quantum of pension or family pension increases proportionally with age, ranging from 20% to 100% of the pension or family pension amount.
 
• The Bill specifies that individuals become eligible for the additional pension or family pension from the first day of the month in which they reach the minimum age specified within the relevant age bracket.
